Subject: EU-only hosting confirmation + PrivateLink operator contacts

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well. As we move through procurement we need a concise evidence pack to present to our security and legal teams. Specifically Aurelius needs: a single-page statement confirming EU-only data residency for the production model endpoints (no routing to non-EU regions), confirmation that PrivateLink/VPC peering is available for an EU deployment, and a list of operator contacts (people who would be listed for network/peering coordination and escalation).

Can you also confirm whether Redwood can provide a CAIQ/SIG appendix scoped to the EU deployment variant and a SOC 2 mapping summary for token retention and access logs? We are aiming to close the contract by the end of May and would like the packet by Friday next week if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Samir Bose
Head of Cloud Security, Aurelius Health

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:

- EU-only hosting: yes — we can commit to serving production requests from EU-only regions for the model variants you pin to (we will include the operator-level route and fallback policy in the packet).
- PrivateLink / VPC peering: supported for our Private (VPC) deployment; we’ll include a connectivity checklist and operator contact roster.
- CAIQ / SIG appendix and SOC 2 mapping: we can deliver an EU-scoped CAIQ/SIG appendix plus a one-page SOC 2 control mapping focused on logging and retention for your procurement team.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send a draft "handshake checklist" that lists the artifacts we’ll provide and the expected owners on both sides.
2) Irene — can you assemble the CAIQ appendix (EU-scoped) and a SOC 2 control extract for data residency/logging controls?
3) Marissa — can you prepare the operator contact CSV and any peering runbook fragments we can share under NDA?

Samir — can you confirm whether your KMS requirement is: (a) customer-managed keys in EU KMS, or (b) Redwood-managed keys with EU residency? That will determine the keystore appendix.

I’ve started a draft checklist (attached) — it’s a lightweight workbook we’ll populate and share. If a short call next week makes sense, I can book 20 minutes.

Best,
Sofia

Marissa (ops/onboarding):

Attachments I’m including: draft handshake workbook (residency_handshake_checklist.xlsx) and a stub operator list (redwood_vpc_operator_list.csv). I will collate the CAIQ appendix once Irene drops it in the Drive folder and add a DocuSign-ready statement if Legal approves.
